newsitem.title: USA: Sterling Bancorp to redeem debentures.
newsitem.headline: Sterling Bancorp to redeem debentures.

text.p: Sterling Bancorp said Thursday that it plans to prepay and redeem $7,163,000 of its floating interest rate convertible subordinated debentures 4th series due November 1, 1998, constituting about half of the debentures outstanding. The prepayment and redemption date is set for December 17. Holders of the debentures will receive the redemption price of 100 percent of the principal amount of each debenture plus accrued and unpaid interest to the date of the redemption.

Holders will have the right before the redemption date to convert their debentures into common shares. However, no accrued interest will be paid to holders who exercise that right of conversion, the company said.
